title: Hotelogix Integrates Zoho Books: Automate Hotel Accounting #Shorts
description:
Automate hotel accounting by syncing Hotelogix with Zoho Books.

1. In Hotelogix settings, select Integrations and connect your Zoho Books account.
2. Map room revenue categories and local tax rates to corresponding Zoho Books ledger accounts.
3. Turn on automatic sync to push daily checkout folios and guest payments in real time.

AI + Zoho automations every day - follow @GSXAutomation

What inspired this: https://news.google.?oc=5

This video uses an AI-generated presenter and voice.

angle.problem: Hotels waste hours manually retyping daily guest charges and room folios into accounting software.
angle.solution: Enable the new Hotelogix to Zoho Books integration to automatically sync room revenue and guest invoices.
steps: In Hotelogix settings, select Integrations and connect your Zoho Books account.
Map room revenue categories and local tax rates to corresponding Zoho Books ledger accounts.
Turn on automatic sync to push daily checkout folios and guest payments in real time.
angle.result: Eliminates manual bookkeeping errors and saves hotel staff hours every night audit.
angle.wow: Nightly room revenue and tax ledgers sync into Zoho Books completely hands-free.
